test_policy.notes: Undergraduate admission rests on any one of: top 30% of class, ACT composite 21+, or SAT 1060+ (the freshman page says test scores are not required and the top 30% are automatically admitted). The CDS marks SAT/ACT as 'recommended'. International students without a class rank can qualify with SAT 1060 or ACT 21. A recommended high school curriculum of four credits each in English, math, science and social studies is also listed.

requirements.notes: Apply with the university's own application, ApplyTexas or the Common App (choose East Texas A&M). The Apply page lists a $30 application fee for undergraduates (it does not give a separate international fee). Required: official high school transcripts evaluated by an independent credential-evaluation agency (the school does not accept student-submitted unofficial evaluations), English proficiency proof, and a Financial Statement form for the I-20. No financial-documentation dollar amount is listed.

deadlines.label: Freshman priority date (fall 2027 entry, CDS C14)
deadlines.notes: From the CDS (all freshmen); notification is rolling from Oct. 1. The CDS lists a domestic closing date of Aug. 15.

deadlines.label: International fall application deadline (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: International page: Fall Aug. 1, Spring Oct. 1, Summer Mar. 1, with the footnote that applications must be submitted 90 days before the semester starts and that applications received after May 1 are reviewed case by case; the page also says all requirements should be complete at least three months before the semester. Years are not printed; fall 2027 assumed.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waivers: advanced-level Texas Intensive English Program (TIEP) completion; one year at a Texas public high school with English III or IV grade B or better; all secondary/postsecondary education in a listed English-speaking country (e.g. Australia, Canada except Quebec, Ireland, New Zealand, United Kingdom, Jamaica, Ghana); 12+ transferable credits with C or better in ENG 1301 and 1302; GCE/GCSE/IGCSE, WASC, KCSE or SSCE English with C or higher, or IB English grade 4+. Four years of U.S. high school, SAT EBRW 560 or ACT English 21 also satisfy the requirement. The pages describe no conditional admission or ESL program beyond TIEP as a waiver route.

english.notes: Unofficial TOEFL/IELTS scores can be uploaded to the Applicant Portal for verification. The page does not mention the new 1-6 TOEFL scale.
100 minimum score. Gateway English Test (formerly English3) 405 overall is also accepted.

aid.notes: CDS H6: institutional need-based and non-need-based aid are both available to degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates (24 recipients, average $9,622). The international admissions page describes no scholarship amounts, and the cost page lists no non-resident tuition waiver.
